_doc: The class-5 HydroRIVERS reaches the trunks cut leaves out where this map needs them: within 60 km of one of the 61 blast sites, or draining to a closed basin (ENDORHEIC). Same eight fields as hydrography.geojson, plus TAINTED=1 and LOAD (0..1, diluted by discharge) on a reach downstream of a blast site (absent otherwise); NEXT_DOWN may point into that file. Regenerate with tools/build-hydrography.py; do not hand-patch.
